clips.title: The story
paras: In western Dun Morogh, travelers cross Chill Breeze Valley between Kharanos and Gnomeregan. Refugees and young travelers follow its main trail, while dangerous beasts haunt its secluded reaches.

Chill Breeze Valley cuts through the mountains of western Dun Morogh. The main trail runs east to west, carrying young dwarves and gnomes between Kharanos and the outskirts of Gnomeregan. A north-south branch leads into more dangerous ground. Blood stains the snow among mangled carcasses, and savage wendigos make their dens in deep ice caves. They prey on anyone who wanders into their hunting grounds.
